about.title: I’m Rodrigo Bondioli
about.text: I’m Rodrigo Bondioli, a designer and strategist with nearly two decades of experience building digital products, brands, and content. I care less about trends than about finding the angle that makes an idea worth paying attention to. I’ve led creative work for Coca-Cola, Nike, Fiat, and Unilever, and held leadership roles at Netshoes and Americanas.com. The logos matter less than the work: turning complicated ideas into something clear, distinctive, and useful. My work spans UI/UX, brand identity, and creative direction, with technology and strategy built into the process. I take on projects where design can change how a product is understood—not just how it looks.
